capabilities: Highlight the sentence under the cursor
Dim the rest of the document
Remove focus when the editor is scrolled
Re-apply focus when the cursor moves or typing starts
extras: The README is only a few lines; it explains when focus is applied and removed but not how to configure or toggle the plugin.
motivation: The README says the plugin is inspired by iA Writer, implying the author wanted that writing app's focused-sentence style in Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian's editor shows the whole note at equal visual weight, which can make it hard to concentrate on the sentence being written.
summary: Focus mode that highlights the sentence under the cursor and dims the rest of the document while writing.
